thread:
Sasha (CS): Heads-up: several onboarding imports showed missing records after indexing between 01:10-02:00 UTC. Engineering found a schema mapping mismatch that dropped certain fields during transform. We need: customer status blurb, remediation plan, and renewal-impact language.

Tom - CS Ops: Can we segment affected tenants by severity? Recommend categories: critical (blocks go-live), major (partial loss), minor (retryable).

Sasha (CS): Uploaded severity buckets to #cs-ops-docs. Critical: acct-sierra, acct-zen, acct-omega. ~8 trials had partial drops.

Ivy (Support): Customer offer proposal: critical accounts get immediate re-index priority + 15% onboarding credit; major get expedited retry + 7% credit; trials get 30-day extension. Also offer live troubleshooting session for any go-live blockers.

Marco (SRE): Root cause summary: during a schema migration, a null-handling change caused the transform pipeline to silently drop fields when a nested key was absent. Patch deployed at 02:05 UTC. Backfill/re-index jobs started. Logs: `transform/pipeline: WARN dropped 421 docs`. We're running consistency checks now.

Olivia (Product): If re-index cannot restore user-visible data quickly, propose offering a temporary feature-flagged fallback that skips the new mapping for affected tenants for 72h to ensure import fidelity. That reduces migration risk. Billing + infra signoff needed.

Sasha (CS): Draft customer note for review: "We discovered an internal schema migration issue that caused some imported items to be incomplete after indexing. Engineering patched the pipeline and we are reprocessing affected imports. We will prioritize accounts impacted most and provide an ETA for when your data will be fully available. We apologize for the disruption; your success lead will reach out to coordinate next steps and any required enablement." Edits?

Tom - CS Ops: For renewal-risk accounts add: "If this affects your contractual go-live, we will assign a senior success lead and provide tailored remediation and credit options. We'll escalate to your AM as needed."

Marco (SRE): FAQ blurb: "Cause: schema migration null-handling change in transform pipeline caused field drop for nested records. Fix: rolled back the problematic transform and added guarded parsing + alerting. Mitigation: backfills and verification jobs, plus a post-deploy schema validation gate."

Ivy (Support): Actionable ask: I need the CSV with columns (account, severity, owner, am, contact-email). I will send segmented emails and run the survey link. Can Tom confirm the final list by 11:30am PT?

Sasha (CS): CSV posted to #cs-ops-docs. @Olivia please confirm credit thresholds. @Marco please post re-index progress numbers.

Olivia (Product): Billing ok to pre-approve credits: up to 20% for accounts <$3k MRR; 10% for $3k-$10k MRR with AM approval for higher. Temporary fallback needs infra tagging; will coordinate.

Marco (SRE): Progress 02:45 UTC: 60% of affected imports reprocessed; data verification pass on 40%. New ETA for completion: 2-5 hours depending on queue size. Monitoring stream: `reindex/verify`. I'll post updates every 20-30 minutes.

Tom - CS Ops: I'll prepare three templates: critical-account brief (with AM escalation), major-issue note, and trial extension note. Sharing in 10m for quick signoff.

NotifyBot: Templates uploaded to #cs-review (link). Requesting signoff from @Sasha, @Olivia, @Marco. :bell:

Sasha (CS): Also capturing feedback: include a 3-question pulse: 1) Did this block your go-live? (Yes/No) 2) Do you want a live troubleshooting session? (Yes/No) 3) Optional comments. We'll feed results into the renewal-risk tracker.

Ivy (Support): I'll wire the survey and automate tagging of responses in the CS tracker. Also will triage any direct replies to on-call success.

Marco (SRE): Postmortem ETA: EOD tomorrow. We'll include timeline, root cause, test plan, and deploy safeguards (schema-validation gate + new alert). Owners assigned.

Sasha (CS): Reminder: cc billing@redwood.com on credits and loop AMs for potential renewal impacts. I'll schedule enablement reslots and send calendar invites for critical accounts.

Olivia (Product): I'll notify AMs for accounts >$5k MRR. Also exploring automating rollback for migration toggles going forward.

Tom - CS Ops: Once we have final signoff, I'll run segmented sends and schedule follow-ups in the calendar.

Ivy (Support): Standing by to monitor inbound replies and escalate urgent issues.

Marco (SRE): Will post next progress update in 20m.

Sasha (CS): Thanks team — executing the plan now. Will post send time and recipients after signoff."
